attribution: Auxiliary research implementation using public Tahoe target annotations and the public GO graph supplied by TxPert. Not STATE, not a TxPert checkpoint replication.

automatic_identification.context: NCI-H596 from c39.obs.cell_name; official Tahoe metadata cross-links ACH-000628 and CVCL_1571
automatic_identification.species: human cell line, provider context annotation; not inferred from gene capitalization
automatic_identification.genes: 1969 named coordinates frozen in the existing registered axis; 31 unresolved coordinates excluded from this auxiliary endpoint, not invented
automatic_identification.actions: single-drug dose tuples parsed with ast.literal_eval; exact provider drug-name matches only
automatic_identification.chemical_groups: RDKit FragmentParent + Uncharger, InChIKey connectivity block; salts grouped before outcome access
automatic_identification.public_graph: TxPert revision 08d82eea86746b044cf7531f4ec8c5f60e1cb73f, GO similarity graph, 9853 nodes/470783 weighted directed rows

facts_and_hypotheses.statement: Trametinib inhibits MEK1/2; MAP2K1 participates in the ERK1/2 cascade.
sources: knowledge_sources/chembl_trametinib_mechanism.raw: mechanisms[0], CHEMBL2103875/CHEMBL2111289 and linked FDA records
facts_and_hypotheses.applicability: target/pathway knowledge only; does not assert NCI-H596 dose-specific response or state gain

facts_and_hypotheses.statement: Provider cell metadata lists NCI-H596 PIK3CA p.E545K as gain-of-function, with RB1 and TP53 alterations.
facts_and_hypotheses.level: provider annotation, not new genotype measurement
facts_and_hypotheses.hypothesis: PI3K pathway state could modify sensitivity to pathway interventions, but genotype alone does not prove sensitivity or determine the best dose.

facts_and_hypotheses.statement: Drugs with similar annotated targets and GO neighborhoods may share transcriptional responses.
facts_and_hypotheses.feature_realization: sparse multi-target vectors; weighted one-step GO neighborhood expansion plus self edges; L2 row normalization; dose-interacted kernel ridge alpha=1
facts_and_hypotheses.result: Retrospective GO model MSE exceeds the dose-only comparator by 4.6749%; it does not beat the no-change baseline. No superiority is claimed.

knowledge_quality.status: provider-annotated drug targets with original row/hash trace; one mechanism chain independently checked via ChEMBL/UniProt
knowledge_quality.unsupported_tokens: retained in knowledge_rows.json; exact-match exclusions have reasons
knowledge_quality.graph_scope: public TxPert GO subset does not cover all human drug targets; 743 deposited condition/plate groups lack an exact target in this graph
knowledge_quality.retrospective_exposure: c39 was historically explored before this run; the new fold freeze does not erase that exposure

factorial_status.A_vs_C: auxiliary retrospective knowledge comparison with no per-question state features; predictions are control-centered expression deltas, training-only reference controls saved per fold
factorial_status.B_vs_A: not_run: legal predecision RNA not certified
factorial_status.D_vs_C: not_run: legal predecision RNA not certified
factorial_status.STATE_A_vs_B: identical-baseline technical equality only, not biological efficacy
